sqlMap.select: SELECT H.ORD_NO AS ordNo, H.ORD_DT AS ordDt, C.CUST_NM AS custNm, D.ITEM_SEQ AS itemSeq, P.PRD_NM AS prdNm, D.ORD_QTY * D.UNIT_PRC AS lineAmt FROM TB_ORD_H H INNER JOIN TB_CUST_M C ON C.CUST_NO = H.CUST_NO INNER JOIN TB_ORD_D D ON D.ORD_NO = H.ORD_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PRD_M P ON P.PRD_CD = D.PRD_CD AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE H.ORD_NO = #ordNo# ORDER BY D.ITEM_SEQ
SELECT H.ORD_NO AS ordNo, CC.CD_NM AS statNm FROM TB_ORD_H H, TB_CMM_CD CC WHERE CC.GRP_CD = 'ORD_STAT' AND CC.CD = H.ORD_STAT_CD AND H.ORD_NO = #ordNo#
